name: cari_ara
description: Ünvanında aranan ifade geçen cari kartları listeler (kod, ünvan, şehir).
sql: SELECT CODE AS cari_kodu, DEFINITION_ AS unvan, CITY AS sehir FROM LG_001_CLCARD WHERE ACTIVE = 0 AND DEFINITION_ LIKE :arama ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY CODE

name: cari_bakiye
description: Cari kartın bakiyesini döner (borç - alacak; pozitif = müşteri borçlu).
sql: SELECT C.CODE AS cari_kodu, C.DEFINITION_ AS unvan, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN L.SIGN = 0 THEN L.AMOUNT ELSE -L.AMOUNT END), 0) AS bakiye_tl FROM LG_001_CLCARD C LEFT JOIN LG_001_01_CLFLINE L ON L.CLIENTREF = C.LOGICALREF WHERE C.CODE = :cari_kodu GROUP BY C.CODE, C.DEFINITION_

name: cari_hareketleri
description: Cari kartın verilen tarihten sonraki hareketleri (tarih, tutar, borç/alacak).
sql: SELECT L.DATE_ AS tarih, L.AMOUNT AS tutar_tl, CASE WHEN L.SIGN = 0 THEN 'Borç' ELSE 'Alacak' END AS tur FROM LG_001_01_CLFLINE L JOIN LG_001_CLCARD C ON C.LOGICALREF = L.CLIENTREF WHERE C.CODE = :cari_kodu AND L.DATE_ >= :baslangic ORDER BY L.DATE_

name: stok_miktari
description: Stok kartının tüm ambarlardaki eldeki miktarını döner.
sql: SELECT I.CODE AS stok_kodu, I.NAME AS stok_adi, COALESCE(SUM(T.ONHAND), 0) AS eldeki_miktar, I.UNIT AS birim FROM LG_001_ITEMS I LEFT JOIN LG_001_01_GNTOTST T ON T.STOCKREF = I.LOGICALREF AND T.INVENNO = -1 WHERE I.CODE = :stok_kodu GROUP BY I.CODE, I.NAME, I.UNIT

name: cari_not_ekle
description: Cari karta RECOrion notu ekler (Logo tablolarına değil, ayrı RECORION_NOTLAR tablosuna).
